title: Marketplace catalog
description: JSON Schema for the marketplace.json file at the root of a plugin repository — the catalog that LinkDesk reads when the user adds your repository as a marketplace source. Publish (`linkdesk-plugin-sdk publish`) maintains this file for you via the GitHub Contents API (read sha → merge entry → PUT); hand-editing is for review/setup only. Field set mirrors the TS contract `CatalogPluginEntry` / `MarketplaceCatalog` in @linkdesk/plugin-sdk (spec §三/§3.2) — the code is the single source of truth; missing fields never crash the publisher (entries merge additively).

version.description: Catalog format version. Written by the publisher; keep whatever is already there.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last publish. Written by the publisher.

plugins.description: One entry per plugin in this repository. The publisher upserts by `id`: new id appends, existing id merges (your new version/history in, description/icon falling back to previous values).

id.description: Plugin identity (plugin.json `pluginId`) — dedup key for the whole catalog. Immutable once published.

name.description: Display name shown in the marketplace list.

version.description: Latest published version (mirrors versions[0].version — kept for backward compatibility with old catalog entries).

description.description: Short description shown in the marketplace list.

icon.description: Small UI icon of the installed plugin. Published as a remote raw URL (raw.githubusercontent.com/<owner>/<repo>/v<version>/…): uninstalled users' clients fetch it from here. Note: the icon bar force-tints this image, so a coloured picture turns into a blob — that is what marketIcon is for (the three-image model is documented in the authoring guide).

iconSource.description: Where the icon value came from (publisher bookkeeping).

marketIcon.description: Coloured identity image for marketplace display (Type-2 of the three-image model) — the marketplace row reads this one, not the tinted icon-bar silhouette. Remote raw URL, same shape as icon.

marketIconSource.description: Where the marketIcon value came from (publisher bookkeeping).

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL of the latest .linkdesk-plugin asset (the GitHub Release asset).

size.description: Asset size in bytes (shown in the marketplace UI).

publishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the latest publish.

minAppVersion.description: Minimum host (app) version this plugin accepts — the marketplace uses it to refuse installs on older hosts (pool-supplied plugins must declare it). Mirrors plugin.json `minAppVersion`.

readmeUrl.description: Remote raw URL of the repository README.md — the 'Details' tab of an uninstalled plugin renders this. Written automatically by publish when a README.md exists at the project root (same tag as the zip ⇒ what you see uninstalled equals what you get installed). No README.md ⇒ field omitted.

versions.description: Version history, NEWEST FIRST — the update mechanism's data source. The publisher appends; do not reorder by hand.

downloadUrl.description: Direct download URL of this version's asset.

changelog.description: Release notes for this version (sliced from the repository CHANGELOG.md's matching section at publish time; rendered in the uninstalled 'Changelog' tab).
